message: The other day, while watching the weather report, I couldn't help but chuckle at my own smugness. You see, I had spent an entire weekend organizing our emergency supplies—bottled water, batteries, the whole shebang—while my family rolled their eyes at my 'over-preparedness.' Fast forward to that evening, and wouldn't you know it, the weather turned nasty. As the winds howled outside, I sipped my tea, feeling quite pleased with myself. It's funny how a little planning can make you feel like a superhero, even if you're just in your living room. Have you ever had one of those 'I told you so' moments? ☕
